package domain_test

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"strings"
	"testing"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain"
)

const (
	turnID        = "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111"
	dialogID      = "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222"
	messageID     = "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333"
	studentID     = "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444"
	teacherID     = "55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555"
	commandID     = "66666666-6666-4666-8666-666666666666"
	replyID       = "77777777-7777-4777-8777-777777777777"
	secondTurnID  = "88888888-8888-4888-8888-888888888888"
	jobID         = "99999999-9999-4999-8999-999999999999"
	outcomeID     = "aaaaaaaa-aaaa-4aaa-8aaa-aaaaaaaaaaaa"
	aiExecutionID = "bbbbbbbb-bbbb-4bbb-8bbb-bbbbbbbbbbbb"
	actionReceipt = "cccccccc-cccc-4ccc-8ccc-cccccccccccc"
	noEffectProof = "dddddddd-dddd-4ddd-8ddd-dddddddddddd"
	sourcePrompt  = "eeeeeeee-eeee-4eee-8eee-eeeeeeeeeeee"
	canonicalMsg  = "ffffffff-ffff-4fff-8fff-ffffffffffff"
)

func turnOrder(id string, denseSequence, sourceMessageSequence int64) domain.TeacherTurnOrder {
	return domain.TeacherTurnOrder{
		DialogID: dialogID, SourceEventID: id, TeacherTurnSequence: denseSequence,
		SourceMessageSequence: sourceMessageSequence,
	}
}

func TestTeacherJobTurnCorrelationRequiresBoundaryIdentityFields(t *testing.T) {
	correlation := domain.TeacherJobTurnCorrelation{
		SourceEventID: turnID, TeacherTurnSequence: 1, DialogID: dialogID,
		CanonicalStudentMessageID: messageID, SourceMessageSequence: 12,
		StudentID: studentID, PersonalTeacherID: teacherID,
		TeacherJobID: jobID, ActionReceiptID: actionReceipt, StudentCommandID: commandID,
		AIExecutionID: aiExecutionID, CorrelationID: actionReceipt, CausationID: turnID,
	}
	if _, err := domain.NormalizeTeacherJobTurnCorrelation(correlation); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("valid correlation: %v", err)
	}
	correlation.CausationID = ""
	if _, err := domain.NormalizeTeacherJobTurnCorrelation(correlation); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("missing causation_id must be rejected")
	}
	correlation.CausationID = turnID
	correlation.ActionReceiptID = ""
	correlation.CorrelationID = messageID
	correlation.CanonicalStudentMessageID = messageID
	if _, err := domain.NormalizeTeacherJobTurnCorrelation(correlation); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("valid text-turn correlation: %v", err)
	}
	correlation.CausationID = turnID
	correlation.TeacherJobID = "not-a-uuid"
	if _, err := domain.NormalizeTeacherJobTurnCorrelation(correlation); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("malformed optional shared ID must be rejected")
	}
}

func TestTeacherActionReceiptEvidenceMatchesDialogContract(t *testing.T) {
	evidence := domain.TeacherActionReceiptEvidence{
		Schema: domain.TeacherActionReceiptEvidenceSchema, Kind: domain.TeacherActionReceiptEvidenceKind,
		ActionReceiptID: actionReceipt, SourcePromptMessageID: sourcePrompt, SourcePromptMessageVersion: 3,
		BlockID: "onboarding.direction.v1", ActionID: "go",
		SourceUIDigest: "0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef",
	}
	correlation := domain.TeacherJobTurnCorrelation{
		SourceEventID: turnID, TeacherTurnSequence: 1, DialogID: dialogID,
		CanonicalStudentMessageID: canonicalMsg, SourceMessageSequence: 12,
		StudentID: studentID, PersonalTeacherID: teacherID, TeacherJobID: jobID,
		ActionReceiptID: actionReceipt, CorrelationID: actionReceipt, CausationID: turnID,
	}
	if _, err := domain.NormalizeTeacherActionReceiptEvidence(evidence); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("valid Dialog-compatible evidence: %v", err)
	}
	upperDigest := evidence
	upperDigest.SourceUIDigest = "0123456789ABCDEF0123456789ABCDEF0123456789ABCDEF0123456789ABCDEF"
	normalizedUpperDigest, err := domain.NormalizeTeacherActionReceiptEvidence(upperDigest)
	if err != nil || normalizedUpperDigest.SourceUIDigest != evidence.SourceUIDigest {
		t.Fatalf("digest should canonicalize to lowercase like Dialog: value=%q err=%v", normalizedUpperDigest.SourceUIDigest, err)
	}
	if err := domain.ValidateTeacherActionReceiptForJobTurn(evidence, correlation); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("evidence must bind to action turn: %v", err)
	}
	for name, mutate := range map[string]func(*domain.TeacherActionReceiptEvidence){
		"missing source prompt version": func(value *domain.TeacherActionReceiptEvidence) { value.SourcePromptMessageVersion = 0 },
		"non-ascii block id":            func(value *domain.TeacherActionReceiptEvidence) { value.BlockID = "方向" },
		"overlong action id":            func(value *domain.TeacherActionReceiptEvidence) { value.ActionID = string(make([]byte, 129)) },
		"invalid digest":                func(value *domain.TeacherActionReceiptEvidence) { value.SourceUIDigest = "not-a-sha256" },
	} {
		invalid := evidence
		mutate(&invalid)
		if _, err := domain.NormalizeTeacherActionReceiptEvidence(invalid); err == nil {
			t.Fatalf("%s must be rejected", name)
		}
	}
	textTurn := correlation
	textTurn.ActionReceiptID = ""
	textTurn.CorrelationID = canonicalMsg
	if err := domain.ValidateTeacherActionReceiptForJobTurn(evidence, textTurn); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("action evidence must not bind to a text turn")
	}
}

func cursor(id string, denseSequence, sourceMessageSequence int64, outcome domain.TeacherTurnTerminalOutcome) domain.TeacherTurnCursor {
	result := domain.TeacherTurnCursor{Order: turnOrder(id, denseSequence, sourceMessageSequence), Outcome: outcome}
	if outcome == domain.TeacherTurnDelivered {
		result.TeacherResponseMessageID = replyID
	}
	if outcome == domain.TeacherTurnFailedNoEffect {
		result.NoEffectProofID = noEffectProof
		result.FailureCode = "dependency_unavailable"
		result.RecoverableOutcomeID = outcomeID
	}
	return result
}

func reconciliationCursor(id string, denseSequence, sourceMessageSequence int64, state domain.TeacherTurnReconciliationState) domain.TeacherTurnCursor {
	return domain.TeacherTurnCursor{Order: turnOrder(id, denseSequence, sourceMessageSequence), ReconciliationState: state}
}

func TestTeacherTurnOrderUsesDenseDialogSequence(t *testing.T) {
	previous := turnOrder(turnID, 1, 101)
	// Source-message evidence may gap or move independently from the dense
	// Teacher turn sequence because other Dialog messages share that counter.
	if err := domain.ValidateTeacherTurnOrder(&previous, turnOrder(secondTurnID, 2, 1)); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("next dense turn should advance: %v", err)
	}
	if err := domain.ValidateTeacherTurnOrder(&previous, turnOrder(secondTurnID, 3, 102)); err != domain.ErrTeacherTurnOutOfOrder {
		t.Fatalf("dense gap must be rejected, got %v", err)
	}
	if err := domain.ValidateTeacherTurnEligibility(1, turnOrder(secondTurnID, 2, 2)); err != domain.ErrTeacherTurnOutOfOrder {
		t.Fatalf("turn 2 before turn 1 must be ineligible, got %v", err)
	}
	if err := domain.ValidateTeacherTurnOrder(nil, turnOrder(secondTurnID, 2, 2)); err != domain.ErrTeacherTurnOutOfOrder {
		t.Fatalf("first turn must be dense sequence 1, got %v", err)
	}
	foreign := turnOrder(secondTurnID, 2, 102)
	foreign.DialogID = "99999999-9999-4999-8999-999999999999"
	if err := domain.ValidateTeacherTurnOrder(&previous, foreign); err != domain.ErrTeacherTurnOutOfOrder {
		t.Fatalf("foreign dialog must be rejected, got %v", err)
	}
}

func TestTeacherTurnCursorAdvancesOnlyAfterSafeTerminalOutcome(t *testing.T) {
	previous := cursor(turnID, 1, 101, domain.TeacherTurnDelivered)
	for _, state := range []domain.TeacherTurnReconciliationState{
		domain.TeacherTurnUnknown, domain.TeacherTurnPartial, domain.TeacherTurnCommittedUnreconciled,
	} {
		if err := domain.ValidateTeacherTurnCursorAdvance(&previous, reconciliationCursor(secondTurnID, 2, 103, state)); err != domain.ErrTeacherTurnCursorBlocked {
			t.Fatalf("%s must block advancement, got %v", state, err)
		}
	}
	if err := domain.ValidateTeacherTurnCursorAdvance(&previous, cursor(secondTurnID, 2, 103, domain.TeacherTurnDelivered)); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("delivered outcome should advance: %v", err)
	}
	if err := domain.ValidateTeacherTurnCursorAdvance(&previous, cursor(secondTurnID, 2, 103, domain.TeacherTurnFailedNoEffect)); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("proven no-effect failure should advance: %v", err)
	}
}

func TestTeacherTurnTerminalOutcomeRequiresProof(t *testing.T) {
	delivered := cursor(turnID, 1, 101, domain.TeacherTurnDelivered)
	if _, err := domain.NormalizeTeacherTurnCursor(delivered); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("valid delivery: %v", err)
	}
	encoded, err := json.Marshal(delivered)
	if err != nil || !strings.Contains(string(encoded), `"teacher_response_message_id":"`+replyID+`"`) || strings.Contains(string(encoded), "canonical_teacher_reply_message_id") {
		t.Fatalf("delivered message JSON field must be standardized: %s (err=%v)", encoded, err)
	}
	noEffect := cursor(turnID, 1, 101, domain.TeacherTurnFailedNoEffect)
	if _, err := domain.NormalizeTeacherTurnCursor(noEffect); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("failed_no_effect without attempted Student command should be valid: %v", err)
	}
	noEffect.StudentCommandID = commandID
	if _, err := domain.NormalizeTeacherTurnCursor(noEffect); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("failed_no_effect with attempted but uncommitted Student command should be valid: %v", err)
	}
	noEffect = cursor(turnID, 1, 101, domain.TeacherTurnFailedNoEffect)
	noEffect.RecoverableOutcomeID = ""
	if _, err := domain.NormalizeTeacherTurnCursor(noEffect); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("failed_no_effect without durable recoverable outcome must be rejected")
	}
	noEffect = cursor(turnID, 1, 101, domain.TeacherTurnFailedNoEffect)
	noEffect.NoEffectProofID = ""
	if _, err := domain.NormalizeTeacherTurnCursor(noEffect); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("failed_no_effect without no-effect proof ID must be rejected")
	}
	noEffect = cursor(turnID, 1, 101, domain.TeacherTurnFailedNoEffect)
	noEffect.FailureCode = ""
	if _, err := domain.NormalizeTeacherTurnCursor(noEffect); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("failed_no_effect without bounded failure code must be rejected")
	}
	unknown := reconciliationCursor(turnID, 1, 101, domain.TeacherTurnUnknown)
	unknown.TeacherResponseMessageID = replyID
	if _, err := domain.NormalizeTeacherTurnCursor(unknown); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("blocking state cannot claim a reply")
	}
	acceptedButUndelivered := cursor(turnID, 1, 101, domain.TeacherTurnDelivered)
	acceptedButUndelivered.TeacherResponseMessageID = ""
	acceptedButUndelivered.StudentCommandID = commandID
	if _, err := domain.NormalizeTeacherTurnCursor(acceptedButUndelivered); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("accepted Student command alone must not be terminal")
	}
}

func TestOneLogicalStudentTurnAcceptsAtMostOneTransition(t *testing.T) {
	ledger, replay, err := domain.AcceptStudentTransition(domain.TeacherStudentTransitionLedger{}, turnID, commandID)
	if err != nil || replay || ledger.StudentCommandID != commandID || ledger.SourceEventID != turnID {
		t.Fatalf("first transition: ledger=%+v replay=%v err=%v", ledger, replay, err)
	}
	if _, replay, err = domain.AcceptStudentTransition(ledger, turnID, commandID); err != nil || !replay {
		t.Fatalf("same command should be replay: replay=%v err=%v", replay, err)
	}
	if _, _, err = domain.AcceptStudentTransition(ledger, turnID, replyID); err != domain.ErrMultipleStudentTransitions {
		t.Fatalf("different command must be rejected: %v", err)
	}
}

func TestTeacherReplyRetryReplaysWithoutDuplicateMessage(t *testing.T) {
	ledger, replay, err := domain.RecordTeacherReply(domain.TeacherReplyLedger{}, turnID, jobID, commandID, messageID)
	if err != nil || replay {
		t.Fatalf("first reply: ledger=%+v replay=%v err=%v", ledger, replay, err)
	}
	if _, replay, err = domain.RecordTeacherReply(ledger, turnID, jobID, commandID, messageID); err != nil || !replay {
		t.Fatalf("same reply should replay: replay=%v err=%v", replay, err)
	}
	if _, _, err = domain.RecordTeacherReply(ledger, turnID, jobID, replyID, messageID); err != domain.ErrDuplicateTeacherReply {
		t.Fatalf("different command must not append a second reply: %v", err)
	}
	if _, _, err = domain.RecordTeacherReply(ledger, turnID, replyID, commandID, messageID); err != domain.ErrDuplicateTeacherReply {
		t.Fatalf("different job must not append a second reply: %v", err)
	}
	if _, _, err = domain.RecordTeacherReply(ledger, turnID, jobID, commandID, replyID); err != domain.ErrDuplicateTeacherReply {
		t.Fatalf("different message must not replace committed reply: %v", err)
	}
}

func TestTeacherLLMBoundaryForbidsStudentMutation(t *testing.T) {
	valid := domain.TeacherTurnLLMContract{
		SourceEventID: turnID, TeacherJobID: jobID, AIExecutionID: aiExecutionID,
		Boundary: domain.TeacherTurnLLMBoundary, TemplateCode: domain.TeacherResponseTemplateCode,
		ResponseSchemaCode: domain.TeacherResponseSchemaCode,
	}
	if _, err := domain.NormalizeTeacherTurnLLMContract(valid); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("AI Prompt-only contract should pass: %v", err)
	}
	valid.StudentMutationRequested = true
	if _, err := domain.NormalizeTeacherTurnLLMContract(valid); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("LLM student mutation request must be rejected")
	}
	valid.StudentMutationRequested = false
	valid.Boundary = "openai"
	if _, err := domain.NormalizeTeacherTurnLLMContract(valid); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("direct provider boundary must be rejected")
	}
}
